annotations.title: NicheDB: Where to Buy a Book

description:
[NicheDB] Where to buy a book. Give an `isbn` (10 or 13 digits, hyphens fine), or a `title` and `author`, or `item` (a books-collection item id). Answers with the edition from Open Library (title, authors, publisher, pages, cover), `online`: links at Amazon, Bookshop.org, Barnes & Noble, Books-A-Million, Target, Walmart, Powell's, ThriftBooks, Better World Books, AbeBooks, eBay, BookFinder, Google Play Books, Kobo, Libby and WorldCat, each with `kind` (new, used, ebook, borrow) and `sponsored`. Give a US `zip` for `inStore`: the chains' store finders for that ZIP and the bookshops and libraries within 10 miles from OpenStreetMap, with address, phone, hours and distance. Most sellers publish no stock or prices, so call a shop with the ISBN; `statedOffers` lists the ones whose own page data does state a price and stock for this ISBN (from the product graph, with `seenAt`).

Served by NicheDB (https://nichedb.dev/docs/mcp).

author.description: Author, with a title (optional), e.g. Jane Austen

isbn.description: ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, hyphens fine (optional), e.g. 978-0-14-143951-8

title.description: Title, when there is no ISBN (optional), e.g. Pride and Prejudice

zip.description: A US ZIP code for shops near you (optional), 5 digits, e.g. 97209
